## [1.1.0](https://github.com/twelvehouse/gboard-ios-style-jp-en-morphe-patches/compare/v1.0.2...v1.1.0) (2026-11-14)

### ✨ New Features

* mark the active mode key of the Japanese 12-key keyboards ([8ca9a46](https://github.com/twelvehouse/gboard-ios-style-jp-en-morphe-patches/commit/8ca9a46f52be205e77978234e26f73c95fcaacdd))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* show keyboard layout changes after an update without clearing data ([6fc6db4](https://github.com/twelvehouse/gboard-ios-style-jp-en-morphe-patches/commit/6fc6db47a0bbe7a20f6096a598e39031b1d8ddf0))

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Installs the patched Gboard as a separate app next to the stock Gboard, which is usually a system app that cannot be replaced by an APK with another signature.

options.description: The package name of the patched Gboard.

patches.name: iOS QWERTY layout
patches.description: Puts the globe key of the letter keyboards at the bottom left, where it is on the Japanese 12-key keyboards, and lays out the English symbol keyboard like the iOS "123" and "#+=" pages. Gboard's number row setting keeps working.

patches.name: iOS flick layout
patches.description: Changes the Japanese 12-key keyboard to the layout of iOS with "flick only" enabled: 123, ABC and あいう keys and the globe key on the left, and backspace, space and a two-row enter key on the right.

options.description: Makes the 123, ABC or あいう key of the keyboard that is shown pill-shaped, like the globe key. Turn it off to keep all three keys rectangular.
